jobs.title: Creative Director, Creative Publishing [Remote]
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what's next.



As the world's foremost entertainment company, Netflix is looking for thoughtful, collaborative, courageous, and skillful creatives to join our gaming division in order to revolutionize entertainment.



We connect people globally with movies and shows by delivering outstanding content and technological innovation through the world's leading streaming entertainment app, with more than 240 million memberships in over 190 countries. Members can watch as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and now they can enjoy an expanding collection of Netflix curated and produced Games.



At Netflix, we have an insatiable need to continually improve our product experience and the creative elements that support it, providing great value to our members, and this team sits at the forefront of the effort.



About the Job



Creative Publishing is Netflix's creative leadership for games, maintaining a consistently high bar across our portfolio. We are seeking a highly-skilled Creative Director to help us align vision and player experience across a key portfolio vertical within Netflix Games.



You will guide and support titles from initial concept through production, launch, and live operations. You will foster a culture of bold experimentation and craft excellence, ensuring our games leave players with memorable experiences that stand the test of time. We're looking for new teammates who care deeply about the experiences they create and the people they make them with. Those who bias towards action and are energized by the learning that comes with bold experimentation at an agile pace. As a part of Netflix, we strive to hire the best and value integrity, excellence, respect, inclusion, and collaboration.



Responsibilities:

• Deeply understanding, and then synthesizing the unique advantages and opportunities provided by the Netflix Games platform into a cohesive vision for massively successful games

• Collaborating closely with teams to develop concepts into prototypes that build conviction in direction and vision

• Helping scale creative efforts into full production then supporting them through launch

• Establishing clear creative goals, providing and soliciting actionable creative / team feedback, and using that feedback to improve others' creative contributions



Qualifications:

• At least 10 years of game design experience, including experience as a Creative Director, Game Director, or comparable design leadership role

• Experience working with distributed or external teams

• Ability to articulate critical and meaningful feedback to influence direction without relying on positional authority

• Excellent knowledge of game lifecycle from concept through live service and an understanding of how to tailor creative input to each game's unique requirements

• A record of leading complex cross-functional projects with successful delivery of quality in design, art, audio, narrative, and additional creative fields

• Experience with Live Service and retention-oriented design

• Development and execution of internal creative tools and processes

• Experience with sports and team-play titles a plus

• Licensed IP game experience a plus



About you:

• A proven track record of guiding teams to executional excellence both creatively and strategically

• A history of strong relationships with recognition as a valued partner in meeting company objectives

• An advocate for players, translating their needs, behavioral insights, and innovation into excellent entertainment

• Comfortable working with frequent context switching and bringing clarity to ambiguity

• Excel in a fast-paced, high-volume, high-agency environment

• Entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and committed to embodying Netflix's culture of high performance, curiosity, freedom, and responsibility



Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $260,000.00 - $480,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.



Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .



Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here .



Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.



We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, ag

jobs.title: Creative Director, Art (Fully Remote)
jobs.description:
About VIVO
VIVO is a healthcare marketing agency specializing in consumer health, pharma, and medtech. We are a 100% remote agency with team members all around the US. Being 100% remote means we value constant collaboration, clear communication, personal accountability, and proactive problem solvers.
At VIVO, we believe health is more than a sector; it’s a life-changing mission. We are creators and strategists driven to make healthcare impactful and accessible, from first impressions to lifelong connections. We bring insight, curiosity, and compassion to every project, knowing our work helps patients, doctors, and everyone in between get the care they deserve—when and where it’s needed most. We’re here to challenge the norms and elevate health brands to inspire, engage, and transform lives.


About You
VIVO is a growing independent healthcare agency with ambitious plans for what comes next—and we believe exceptional creative will be central to getting us there.
We’re looking for a Creative Director — Art who can raise our creative bar, lead and grow our Art discipline, and help shape the future of Creative at VIVO.


This is a senior leadership role for someone who is as passionate about building as they are about making: building exceptional work, talented teams, strong creative partnerships, better ways of working, and an agency people notice.


You’ll bring deep roots in art and design, but your creative thinking should extend well beyond the visual. You understand how art, copy and strategy come together to create an idea, and you're comfortable helping lead multidisciplinary teams toward work that's strategically smart, beautifully executed and impossible to ignore.


What You Will Do
Set the Creative Bar.

Own and elevate the visual and creative standard across VIVO's client and agency work.
Lead the development of integrated ideas across digital, social, video, print, experiential and emerging channels.
Be hands-on when it matters—reviewing, challenging, refining and elevating work from concept through execution.
Push healthcare creative beyond the expected and help build a body of work that earns attention from clients, talent and our industry.

Lead Art. Influence Creative.

Lead, mentor and develop VIVO's Art and Design talent, creating clarity around expectations, feedback, growth and accountability.
Partner closely with our Creative Director, Copy to create a highly integrated creative organization where Art and Copy make one another better.
Think beyond your own discipline. Bring a strong point of view to concepts, storytelling, creative strategy and the overall quality of our work.
Evolve the structure, capabilities and future of VIVO's Creative department.

Build, Don't Just Maintain.

Identify the talent, capabilities, processes and tools we need for our next stage of growth.
Develop creative leaders—not just great campaigns.
Create an environment where talented people are challenged, supported and able to do the best work of their careers.
Partner Across the Agency.
Work closely with Strategy, Client Services, Project Management, Editorial and Agency Leadership to turn business problems into powerful, creative solutions.
Build trust across disciplines and eliminate the silos that get in the way of great work.
Be someone our teams want in the room for our most important opportunities and our toughest creative challenges.

Help Grow VIVO.

Play a meaningful role in new business, pitches and organic client growth.
Present ideas and creative vision confidently to senior clients.
Identify opportunities to make our existing client work stronger—and our relationships bigger.
Help build VIVO's external creative reputation through award-worthy work, thought leadership and visibility in the industry.

Embrace What's Next.

Bring curiosity—not fear—to emerging technology.
Help us integrate AI and new tools thoughtfully into concepting, design, content development and production while protecting originality, craft and quality.

What You Bring

15+ years of creative experience with deep roots in art direction/design
Significant experience as a Creative Director, Group Creative Director, or equivalent
A portfolio demonstrating exceptional conceptual thinking and visual craft
Strong network of talent and vendor relationships
Experience leading integrated work across art, copy and multiple channels
A track record of building and developing creative talent
The ability to move between big-picture creative vision and hands-on creative direction
Strong executive presence and confidence presenting to senior clients
Experience contributing to pitches, new business and organic growth
Healthcare, pharma, life sciences, diagnostics, medical device or health-tech experience strongly preferred
AI experience and a strong philosophy about how to integrate it across our agency

But the most important thing is how you think. You're a builder. You care about developing people as much as developing ideas. You have high standards without needing to have all the answers yourself. You know the best creative departments aren't built around one person's ego—they're built around talented people who challenge one another and make the work better together. And you're excited by the opportunity to help shape what VIVO becomes next.
What We Bring
VIVO offers an award-winning culture and comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, financial well-being, professional growth, and work-life balance. Our benefits offerings include:

Medical, dental, vision
Company paid disability & life insurance
401k with match up to 6%
Annual wellness stipend
Professional development allowance
Recognition, rewards, prizes and amazing swag
11 Holidays plus Winter Break and Annual In-Person Retreat
3+ weeks of total paid time off in Year 1

Ask our hiring manager and/or HR team for more information about any or all of our benefits.
Inclusion @ VIVO

Purdue Global:

 Purdue Global's students are working parents, veterans, career changers, and driven adults who strive for more: more recognition, more support, and more opportunity. They're not going back to school; they're coming back bigger, stronger, and more prepared than ever, with a degree they're proud of and employers respect. 




 Every piece of content is a chance to show these students what's possible, and that genuinely changes lives. 



Our Opportunity:


 The Creative Director is a visionary leader responsible for shaping and executing the visual and creative identity of Purdue Global. This role will lead a team of designers, copywriters, and multimedia specialists to develop compelling and effective marketing materials across all channels.  Champion a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the creative team.

 Oversee the development and production of all marketing materials, including: 


 Digital advertising (display, social media, video) 


 Website design and content 


 Email marketing templates and content 


 Social media graphics and videos 


 Presentations and other internal communications materials 


 Event materials (as needed) 


 Ensure all creative output is on-brand, visually appealing, and effectively communicates the desired message. 


 Manage the creative workflow, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget. 


 Maintain high standards of quality and accuracy in all creative work. 



Adoption and Oversight of AI Tools:


 Evaluate, integrate, and oversee the ethical and effective use of generative AI tools (e.g., image generation, copywriting assistance) within the creative team’s workflow. 


 Develop internal guidelines and best practices for leveraging AI to enhance creative efficiency and output while maintaining brand integrity and originality. 


 Ensure team members are properly trained on new AI technologies and their appropriate application in creative production. 


 Monitor industry developments in AI/ML as they relate to creative production and recommend strategic adoption of relevant tools. 



Team Leadership & Management:


 Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of designers, copywriters, and multimedia specialists. 


 Provide clear direction, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities. 


 Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment. 


 Manage team resources effectively, including workload allocation and project prioritization. 


 Recruit, hire, and onboard new team members as needed. 



Brand Stewardship:


 Serve as a guardian of the Purdue Global brand. 


 Ensure brand consistency across all channels and touchpoints. 


 Maintain brand guidelines and style guides. 


 Collaborate with other departments (e.g., Admissions, Academics) to ensure brand alignment. 



Collaboration & Communication:


 Work closely with the CMO and other marketing leaders to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns. 


 Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., web developers, IT, academic program directors) to ensure seamless execution of creative projects. 


 Present creative concepts and strategies to stakeholders, effectively communicating the rationale and impact of creative decisions. 


 Manage relationships with external vendors (e.g., agencies, freelancers) as needed. 



Data & Analytics:


 Utilize data and analytics to inform creative decisions and measure the effectiveness of creative campaigns. 


 Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to creative performance. 


 Continuously optimize creative assets based on data-driven insights. 



Experience:


 Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Marketing, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.

 Remote, with occasional travel as needed.

 Exceptional creative vision and strategic thinking abilities.

jobs.title: Creative Director, Paid Social (Remote)
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

About The Role

Forbes Advisor is hiring a Creative Director of Paid Social to own end-to-end creative across our Health vertical, a portfolio that today includes weight loss medications, hair loss, hearing, TRT, and dating. You will concept, write, direct, and supervise editorial on the paid social and native creative that drives acquisition for Forbes and its partners, and you will lead a pod of creatives doing the same. This is a direct-response storyteller's role layered with creative management responsibility.

The role reports into the VP Creative and partners with our Paid Social and Native Buyers, who direct the spend, and vertical General Managers, who own category outcomes.

The successful candidate is a senior creative leader. You are fluent in the modern direct-response canon, comfortable in regulated health categories, and produce video and copy at performance-marketing pace without sacrificing craft. You have built and led creative teams before, and you can run a small team of senior individual contributors (creative leads and editors) and personally taking on high priority projects yourself. You move fluently across content modes (remote UGC, in-studio and on-location shoots, AI-generated content) and pick the right mode for pipeline needs. Above all, you are equally at home concepting on a page, directing on set, supervising an edit, and reviewing your team's work with sharp, useful notes.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to accelerate output without diluting craft, and you will be expected to operate that way from day one. You can articulate where AI sharpens video storytelling and where it weakens it. In short, AI fluency is a baseline expectation. You already use it to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

Responsibilities



Own end-to-end creative for the Health vertical: concept, copy, direction, post, and the operating system(s) that produces it.Lead the Health creative pod (Creative Leads, editors, producers). Hire, develop, and raise the bar across the team. Partner with the VP Creative on org design as the team grows.Concept new storytelling angles and write or supervise scripts from blank page to final cut across paid social and native video. Match production mode to pipeline needs.Direct documentary-style, on-camera interviews with doctors, telehealth providers, patients, and UGC creators. Coach others on the team to direct interviews to the same bar.Collaborate with editors from pre-production through delivery. Own the cut on hero work, supervise the rest.Analyze performance data and use it to drive incremental and step-change creative optimizations that scale.Work fluently inside compliance rails (FDA-style health claims, regulated category guardrails, partner overlays). Keep persuasion and compliance aligned rather than in tension.Provide regular updates on creative performance, hiring, and craft initiatives to the Creative leadership team and to Health vertical stakeholders.Available to travel to locations to film, gather footage, and conduct interviews.

Requirements

10+ years of direct-response creative experience in performance-driven environments (supplements, health, telehealth or comparable), with at least 3 years in a creative management role.Demonstrated experience leading and growing a creative team of 5+ individual contributors across writing, directing, and post.Portfolio of video ads with clear performance attribution. We want to see the actual work and hear the actual results, including work your team produced under your direction.Mastery of direct-response narrative architecture: hook, problem, mechanism, proof, transition, offer, and CTA. Working command of the modern direct-response canon.AI-augmented creative fluency. Regular use of AI tools across ideation, scripting, and post. Production fluency across multiple content modes: remote UGC at volume, in-person studio and location shoots, and AI-generated or AI-assisted content. You can pick the right mode for the brief.Strong on-set craft. You can run a shoot yourself, direct non-actor talent, and hold the bar from concept through final cut.Editorial voice fluency. You can direct an interview that feels like a real conversation and shape a story that feels like a story, not a sales letter shot on camera.Demonstrated speed and volume in performance marketing environments. jobs.title: Creative Director - Design, Enterprise Marketing (Remote)
jobs.description:
For more than 150 years, Zions Bancorporation (ZBC) has built on the dedication and talent of our people, earning recognition as one of the "Best Banks to Work For."

With a $90B market cap, we are a leader in the U.S. banking industry. Throughout seven unique affiliated bank brands who welcome customers at 400 local branches across the West, ZBC is committed to business and commercial banking because we believe that businesses are the cornerstone of thriving communities. Together with consumer banking, wealth services, and robust banking products and services, we are known for our exceptional service and deep local roots.

Today, we are shaping the future of banking-leveraging innovation, strengthening local relationships, sharpening sector expertise, and delivering exceptional value across our family of great banks.

Our newly founded enterprise Marketing team is a transformative organization that puts an in-house Creative Studio arm-in-arm with data, insights, strategy, tech, and governance teams to evolve and elevate how we tell our story and connect with customers. This is a collaborative hub for meaningful and holistic brand building, bold ideas, and breakthrough campaigns.

We are adding a key role: A Creative Director for a new digital banking platform designed to move nimbly into the future and transcend our footprint while leveraging the ZBC foundation of strength and stability. The platform will require an equally dynamic creative leader with bright, modern ideas and deep chops in brand design. This is your opportunity to help build the identity of one of the fastest-growing areas of the organization and join us in setting a new standard for performance-driven design and marketing experiences.

The Creative Director - Design (Enterprise Marketing) will deliver innovative design and creative direction that prioritize innovation while balancing business goals with brand integrity. They will be a culturally savvy self-starter and systems-thinker who uses data and insights to create compelling, conversion-focused work that positions us as a leader in digital-forward business banking.

Initially, this position will lead and execute design and creative leadership within a small, discreet startup team, working directly with leadership, and aligning with Creative Studio executive leaders at regular intervals to ensure holistic brand alignment.

jobs.description:
This is a six-month contract for a senior creative partner to work across a four-brand beauty portfolio – hair, colour cosmetics, skincare and baby care – inside a company formed in 2024 and still actively acquiring, having added its most recent brand as recently as this July: this is a portfolio being built in real time.
   
The Role
 You’ll lead creative direction across all four brands at once – brand identity, digital, social, e-commerce, packaging, retail and campaigns – owning both strategy and execution. That breadth is the point: rather than one brand or a seat in a large department, you’d shape all of it.
   
 You’ll direct product launches and major brand moments from concept through delivery, managing day-to-day creative priorities, workflow and timelines across a lean team of around 30 people, mentoring two direct reports managing external creative partners, and working closely with brand, marketing, product, e-commerce and leadership.
   
 The reporting relationship matters here. You wouldn’t be replacing the existing creative leader; you’d work alongside them as their strategic co-lead. A peer-level partnership, not a hierarchy. You’d bring structure and forward planning to a function that needs both, while staying close to the work yourself.

$170,000 – $180,000 contract rate

Initial six-month contract, with potential for longer-term engagement


The Person
 You’re a Creative Director currently in-house at a beauty or personal care business, or leading a beauty-focused agency and ready to move client-side. You’ve run creative across brand, digital, social, e-commerce, packaging and retail, and you’ve directed photo and video shoots. 


Crucially, you understand how creative works in a retail-driven consumer business, with hands-on experience across both prestige and mass retail accounts. This role is at-will and OpenAI reserves the right to modify base pay and other compensation components at any time based on individual performance, team or company results, or market conditions.

OverviewApplication

About the Team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

 

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Creative Director, Copy to join our growing in-house creative team focused on OpenAI’s business audiences. In this role, you’ll help define how we communicate the value of OpenAI to organizations - from growing businesses and startups to global enterprises and developers building with our technology.

You’ll concept and write across integrated campaigns, product launches, customer stories, events, and other brand moments. You’ll translate complex products, technical capabilities, and business outcomes into clear, compelling ideas that resonate with decision-makers, builders, and teams adopting AI.

This is a deeply hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable developing a big campaign platform, shaping a messaging framework, writing a film script, or refining a headline. You’ll work closely with design, production, product marketing, and communications from the earliest stages of an idea through execution.

To us, creativity is a team sport. Ideas get better when you talk them through and build on each other’s thinking. We value curiosity over certainty, kindness over ego, and the ability to balance creative ambition with clarity and decisiveness.

This role is based in New York, NY. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

 

In this role you will


	
	Concept and write integrated brand campaigns for OpenAI’s business audiences
	
	
	Translate complex products, technical capabilities, and use cases into clear, human, and emotionally resonant stories
	
	
	Develop campaign platforms, messaging frameworks, headlines, scripts, manifestos, and narrative systems
	
	
	Create work that connects OpenAI’s products to meaningful business challenges and outcomes
	
	
	Shape how OpenAI speaks to business leaders, technical decision-makers, developers, and teams adopting AI
	
	
	Write across customer stories, product launches, films, digital experiences, events, social content, and executive communications
	
	
	Partner closely with design, motion, production, brand strategy, and agency teams to bring ideas to life
	
	
	Collaborate with Product Marketing, Sales, Product, Communications, and other partners to understand audiences and business priorities
	
	
	Build flexible messaging systems that can work across industries, audiences, markets, and channels
	
	
	Evolve and steward OpenAI’s voice and tone across business communications
	
	
	Present creative ideas and explain the thinking behind them to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders
	
	
	Move fluidly between high-level concepts and detailed execution, staying close to the work throughout the process
	
	
	Manage multiple complex projects, evolving inputs, and compressed timelines with clarity and confidence
	
	
	Help challenge conventions about what enterprise and technology marketing can look and sound like
